defect.risk: A merge could leave canonical product authority internally contradictory and later reintroduce a mandatory private-artifact/token dependency despite the tokenless baseline decision.
defect.counterhypothesis: The manifest language was merely descriptive and could safely lag the Dockerfile.
defect.falsifier: Require a focused regression to parse manifest.json and prove optional baseline semantics, execution-disabled omission, digest/size admission when embedding, and conditional rather than unconditional final EntityOS acceptance.

semantics: baseline may omit EntityOS only while CLAYVERSE_ENABLE_ENTITYOS_EXEC=0
if EntityOS is staged/embedded, explicit digest, locked size and source-tracked lock identity remain mandatory
EntityOS runtime acceptance is required only where EntityOS is deliberately admitted
